mentions.name: Binku
mentions.description: This is a new Sudoku variant combining traditional Sudoku rules with the rules of Binario/Takuzu, using digits 1-4 as one color and 5-8 as the other. A sample puzzle is playable online, and a polished interface that fits the ruleset better is in development, exploring how deep the puzzle can go.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a newish variant of Sudoku called Binku. It combines the traditional Sudoku rules and adds the rules from a game called Binario/Takuzu (with 1-4 as one color and 5-8 as the other color).
